Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

In the role of a QA/QC Engineer, you'll support our project execution teams in delivering high-quality construction projects on schedule. You will be responsible for coordinating and performing QA/QC activities, including inspections, tests, and closeout requirements, ensuring all work complies with project specifications, drawings, and contract requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review and understand all project contract documents and specifications.
  • Conduct daily site inspections to identify and report defects and ensure subcontractor compliance with Inspection Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Prepare and manage inspection schedules aligned with the project timeline.
  • Perform work and material inspections, ensuring rejected materials are quarantined and removed.
  • Collaborate with execution teams to implement corrective actions and conduct root cause analysis for non-conformances.
  • Monitor Fire & Life Safety installations and ensure compliance with authority regulations.
  • Track project deliverables, inspection approvals, and quality KPIs using analytical tools.
  • Support snagging, project closeout, and defect liability period (DLP) activities.
  • Maintain daily site diaries and QA/QC documentation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a QC Engineer in construction environments.
  • Strong knowledge of construction processes and quality control standards.
  • Experience with project closeout procedures and defect management.

  • Analytical skills and experience with data management and basic data analytics.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Positive attitude, passion, and commitment to quality work.

title: Analista comercial
description:
Sobre a Lobie

A Lobie é a proptech que está revolucionando a gestão de imóveis para investidores. Nascemos de um grupo com mais de 80 anos de história e expertise no mercado imobiliário, combinando a solidez de uma das maiores construtoras do país com a capilaridade de uma administradora líder em gestão de condomínios.

Nossa missão é maximizar a rentabilidade de propriedades localizadas em pontos estratégicos através da locação de curto prazo (Short-Term Rental). Fazemos isso sob o lema

"Low Cost, High Yield" , garantindo uma gestão completa, transparente e altamente eficiente, com uma taxa de ocupação média superior a 85% em nossas mais de 750 unidades contratadas.

A Oportunidade: Analista Comercial Jr. (Last Mile)

Você já se perguntou o que acontece depois que um investidor compra um apartamento na planta? É aí que você entra.

Estamos buscando um(a) Analista Comercial Jr. (Last Mile) para ser a ponte essencial entre a aquisição do imóvel pelo investidor e o início da sua jornada de rentabilidade conosco. Esta não é uma venda tradicional; é o início de um relacionamento de longo prazo. Você será o rosto da Lobie no momento mais crucial: a ativação do ativo do nosso cliente.

Seu papel será garantir que cada investidor que adquire uma unidade em projetos parceiros entenda e adira aos nossos serviços de gestão e decoração, transformando um apartamento vazio em uma máquina de gerar receita.

Seus Desafios Serão:
  • Ativar a carteira de investidores que compram unidades nos empreendimentos parceiros, realizando o primeiro contato pós-compra.
  • Apresentar a tese de investimento da Lobie, demonstrando o potencial de rentabilidade através da nossa gestão especializada em locação de curta temporada.
  • Conduzir a venda do nosso produto
  • Lobie Decor , uma solução completa que inclui projeto de arquitetura, compra de itens com custo reduzido pela escala e gestão total da implementação, deixando a unidade pronta para operar.
  • Construir e nutrir um relacionamento de confiança com os investidores, garantindo uma experiência de onboarding fluida e positiva.
  • Realizar a gestão do funil de vendas e atividades no CRM, assegurando o acompanhamento de todos os leads.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de Operações e Marketing para garantir a passagem de bastão perfeita após a contratação dos serviços.
O que Buscamos em Você:
  • Paixão por pessoas e pela construção de relacionamentos duradouros.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade para gerenciar o "último metro" do processo comercial.
  • Vivência na área comercial ou de relacionamento com o cliente, preferencialmente B2C.
  • Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Interesse pelo mercado imobiliário, de investimentos e/ou design de interiores é um grande diferencial.
Por que se Juntar à Lobie?
  • Impacto Real: Você verá o resultado direto do seu trabalho na receita da companhia e na satisfação dos nossos clientes.
  • Crescimento Acelerado: Faça parte de uma proptech em plena expansão, com o suporte de um dos grupos mais sólidos do setor imobiliário brasileiro.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Trabalhe em um ambiente que combina tecnologia, dados e uma abordagem moderna para um mercado tradicional.
  • Desenvolvimento: Oportunidade de aprender sobre investimentos, mercado imobiliário e vendas consultivas de alto valor.

Se você é uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e movida pelo desafio de transformar um negócio em um relacionamento de sucesso, queremos te conhecer!

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. This role reports directly to the Operations Director and is part of the ALEC Data Centre Solutions core delivery team. What We Offer

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

As a Project Engineer, you’ll oversee all engineering deliverables for your assigned scope, from design validation and approvals to procurement, compliance, and on-site execution. What We Offer

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

title: Offshore Cargo Supervisor
description:
We are looking for an Offshore Cargo Supervisor for one of our clients in O&G, in an offshore position (14 X 14).

Offshore Cargo Supervisor: What will your responsibilities and missions be?

Responsible for supervising, monitoring, and participating in all marine-related activities, such as offloading operations, transshipment with support vessels, cargo handling and cleaning, ballasting operations, tank washing (COW), equipment maintenance, diving operations, and pull-in/pull-out operations. All these activities must be carried out with a focus on safety and in compliance with internal and external procedures and regulations, always in support of the Marine Superintendent and under his authority. He is also jointly responsible for ensuring the readiness and availability of the offshore facility's rescue equipment.

What Profile and Skills are Required for this Cargo Supervisor Position?

  • Nationality: Brazilian Only
  • Local of work: Offshore – onboard FPSOs (boarding points: Jacarepaguá, Macaé, Farol de São Tomé, Cabo Frio, Maricá)
  • English: Intermediate to Advanced

Graduation/Certificate:

  • Minimum: Marine or technical background — e.g., Marinheiro de Convés, CB, Mestre de Cabotagem or equivalent maritime certification.
  • Required Certifications (valid at embark): CBSP, CACI, CESS, MCIA, NR-33 (Confined Space), NR-35 (Work at Heights), H2S Awareness, Benzeno Awareness, GASD, ECOW (modules 1 to 4)
  • Search parameters: COW AND Ballast Operations AND Diving Support AND Lifesaving Equipment AND Offshore Cargo Handling

Experience:

  • Proven experience in offshore cargo operations, marine logistics, ballast management, and tank cleaning procedures
  • Experience coordinating diving support and marine safety inspections
  • Availability for temporary offshore rotation (14x14)

title: Section Manager
description:
Section Manager - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Section Manager, you’ll play a vital role in the successful execution of MEP works across complex data center projects. You’ll lead field productivity, manage change effectively, and ensure technical excellence in every phase.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

About Your Team

You’ll report directly to the Construction Manager, with indirect reporting to the Project Manager, and will lead a team of Site Engineers and Foremen. The section management team ensures quality, safety, productivity, and coordination across MEP disciplines, collaborating closely with planning, QA/QC, procurement, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution across project zones and disciplines.

Your Role

As a Section Manager, you will:

  • Issue daily/weekly installation plans and report progress.
  • Enforce method statements, risk assessments, and DSTI schedules.
  • Track material deliveries in coordination with Project Engineers.
  • Manage change and drawing/spec distribution.
  • Monitor tools, consumables, KPIs, and labour productivity.
  • Ensure HSE and QA/QC compliance at all times.
  • Work week: Monday to Saturday (standard for project-based roles in the region)

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years’ experience in MEP construction or infrastructure
  • Strong knowledge of installation sequencing, QA/QC, and HSE
  • Site leadership and technical documentation experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Estágio em Engenharia de processos
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Principais atividades:

  • Auxiliar na avaliação de documentos técnicos dentro do escopo de processos de tratamento de água e esgoto junto ao gestor;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de planilhas de cálculo, documentos, relatórios ou apresentações;
  • Apoiar em pesquisas em artigos técnicos e literatura especializada.

Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Química ou similares;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Perfil com flexibilidade, alta curiosidade e desejo de aprender;
  • Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido (2 dias presenciais por semana);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Benefícios

  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers.   • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.

  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

title: Principal Pipeline Drafter 25002281
description:
Company Overview:

People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing offshore platforms hundreds of miles from shore, and using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. Here, what you do matters.

Job Overview:

The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2D and 3D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software
  • Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints
  • Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables
  • Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures
  • Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities
  • Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools
  • Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team
  • Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing
  • Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN
  • Identify non-original scope using Change Management System

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in using CAD software, such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings
  • Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints
  • Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings
  • Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines

title: Coordenador(a) de Qualidade
description:
Cox é uma utility global de água e energia verticalmente integrada, na vanguarda da solução dos maiores desafios da transição verde. Com mais de 6.000 funcionários espalhados por 30 países, Cox é construída com base no compromisso de uma equipe dedicada à sustentabilidade e ao progresso de longo prazo.

Buscamos Coordenador(a) de Qualidade para atuar na Divisão de Construção, coordenando time e atividades de todos ao projetos em nível Brasil.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a implantação do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade nas obras, alinhado as diretrizes corporativas.
  • Elaborar, implementar e revisar o Plano da Qualidade das obras, em conformidade com normas técnicas, requisitos do cliente e diretrizes corporativas.
  • Participar e acompanhar auditorias internas e externas.
  • Planejar e coordenar as atividades relacionadas ao controle da qualidade, como inspeções, ensaios e testes de qualidade nos processos construtivos (fundações, montagem de torres, lançamento de cabos, etc.).
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade dos materiais e serviços utilizados, por meio da análise de certificados, ensaios e registros de inspeção.
  • Acompanhar e controlar indicadores de desempenho da qualidade
  • Identificar, investigar e gerenciar não conformidades, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas
  • Promover a cultura da qualidade e da melhoria contínua nos projetos de construção.
  • Dar seguimento ao sistema de requisitos legais, normativos e contratuais relacionados à qualidade.
  • Promover treinamentos e capacitações para a equipe sobre normas e procedimentos de qualidade.
  • Prestar suporte contínuo à área de execução na interpretação e aplicação dos procedimentos de qualidade, assegurando que as atividades em campo estejam alinhadas aos requisitos técnicos, normativos e corporativos.

Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento técnico em projetos de execução de obras de transmissão de energia elétrica
  • Domínio das normas aplicáveis: ABNT NBR ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001.
  • Habilidade em liderança de equipes de qualidade.
  • Capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão com foco em melhoria contínua
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de qualidade, gestão de processos e indicadores
  • Pacote Office avançado
  • Desejável conhecimento na Metodologia BIM

Formação :

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia.
  • MBA ou Pós-graduação em temas relacionados a Qualidade
  • Especialização ou certificações em Qualidade (ISO 9001, Six Sigma, Lean, etc.)

Experiência :

  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança na área de qualidade, preferencialmente nos setores de linhas de transmissão/ energia
  • Atuação como auditor interno e acompanhamento de auditorias externas.

-Dentre os princípios que integram o código de ética da Cox, se encontra como valor fundamental a diversidade e igualdade de oportunidades. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas à PCD.

-Informamos que a Cox cumpre com o disposto na Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados – LGPD, e ao aceitar participar deste processo de seleção e ao enviar seus dados pessoais e sensíveis, será considerado sua ciência e concordância para o tratamento dos mesmos de acordo com a referida lei.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in building relationships with donors, sponsors, alumni, and community partners. The coordinator will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.

title: Site Engineer - MEP
description:
MEP Site Engineer - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Site Engineer - MEP, you’ll be instrumental in delivering world-class mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works across dynamic construction environments. You’ll manage daily site operations, uphold quality and safety standards, and ensure technical integrity from planning through execution.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

Your Role

  • Leading the execution of all MEP installations across designated zones of the project.
  • Translating blueprints into efficient field execution using Time & Motion analysis.
  • Monitoring cost versus allowable outputs and reporting effectively to line managers.
  • Ensuring QA/QC requirements are met — we aim for zero repeat works and flawless delivery.
  • Coordinating with Supervisors, Foremen, and QA/QC Engineers to roll out method statements and risk assessments in line with company and consultant standards.
  • Keeping schedules tight by ensuring timely availability of materials and tools.
  • Managing site documentation: marked-up drawings, progress updates, RFI registers, and more.
  • Escalating key issues that need senior intervention while maintaining control of daily site priorities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • Registered as a Civil Engineer (or eligible).
  • Minimum 7 years hands-on site experience in MEP works.
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera & Microsoft Office Suite .

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Site Manager in ALEC Building, you will be responsible for overseeing all finishing aspects of construction projects including blockwork, POP work, plastering, painting, and carpentry, ensuring timely delivery within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Your Role

  • Develop and control site plans for finishing works, accurately calculating required human and material resources.
  • Create, implement, and enforce comprehensive Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) plans on site.
  • Lead and motivate construction teams, ensuring clear communication and high performance.
  • Collaborate with the Commercial Team to monitor and control construction costs, addressing any anomalies.

  • Interpret and apply technical drawings, tender documents, and contract requirements effectively.
  • Monitor productivity and progress, ensuring accurate measurement and recording of works.
  • Manage testing of technical components, interpreting results and implementing corrective actions.
  • Plan and prepare for upcoming contracts, including tender revision, scheduling, and site setup.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (BEng, BTEC, ND) in Civil Construction or related field.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in construction, preferably in finishing works.
  • Strong leadership, planning, communication, and commercial acumen.
  • Proven ability to manage complex construction projects on time and within budget.
  • Sound knowledge of HSE standards and quality control procedures.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno | DCP
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Planejamento em Prevenção de Perdas atua como o cérebro estratégico da operação, conectando análises financeiras, orçamentárias e contratuais à execução prática das ações de mitigação de perdas em toda a cadeia operacional. Seu papel é garantir o uso eficiente dos recursos destinados à Prevenção de Perdas, por meio do controle rigoroso de orçamento (budget), acompanhamento de CAPEX/OPEX, e gestão de contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia, segurança, auditoria e serviços correlatos.

Além disso, a área é responsável pelo provisionamento e reversão contábil de perdas, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e compliance com normas financeiras. A interlocução com áreas como Controladoria, Compras, Jurídico, Financeiro e Operações é constante, exigindo perfil analítico, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade sobre prazos e entregas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Garantir que os investimentos e despesas da área estejam aderentes ao budget anual, monitorando variações, evitando estouros e propondo realocações estratégicas quando necessário.
  • Assegurar o correto acompanhamento de vigência contratual, SLA, reajustes, aditivos e pagamentos de notas fiscais, evitando atrasos, glosas ou passivos.
  • Atuar como elo entre Prevenção de Perdas e áreas como Financeiro, Controladoria e Jurídico, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em ações financeiras/compliance e vice-versa.
  • Realizar estimativas confiáveis de perdas e investimentos, com metodologia clara para provisionamento e reversões, fundamentando tomadas de decisão do comitê executivo.
  • Equilibrar investimentos de capital (ex: instalação de novas tecnologias) e despesas operacionais (ex: manutenção de sistemas de CFTV) de forma eficiente e transparente.
  • Buscar constantemente formas de reduzir retrabalho, integrar sistemas (ERP, BI, etc.) e melhorar a previsibilidade e rastreabilidade de informações e custos.
  • Contribuir para a construção de um plano de perdas sustentável, que una a inteligência financeira ao propósito de proteger o negócio de riscos e desperdícios.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Domínio em gestão orçamentária e financeira.
  • Conhecimento em gestão contratual e compliance.
  • Habilidade em análise de perdas e provisionamento.
  • Conhecimento em investimentos de capital e despesas operacionais.
  • Vivência com sistemas integrados, como: ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, etc.), BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.)
  • Análise estratégica e mindset de negócios.
  • Pacote Office avançado.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

title: Digital Construction Manager
description:
Digital Construction Manager - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

The Digital Construction Manager leads and oversees BIM-based information management on a project, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and external stakeholders (client, consultants, subcontractors). While their focus is on BIM, the role may extend to other digital construction tools like scanning, drones, and robotics.

Your Role:

  • Manage client expectations for BIM and ensure deliverables meet requirements.
  • Develop and maintain information management resources (BIM Execution Plan, EIRs, MIDP, etc.).
  • Set up BIM workflows and manage the project's CDE (Common Data Environment).
  • Lead 3D coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting.
  • Train and support project teams on BIM processes and tools.
  • Ensure QA/QC of BIM models and deliverables.
  • Report on BIM compliance and progress at the project level.
  • Contribute to tender activities and support process development.

What We're looking For

  • Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 and PAS 1192 standards.
  • Proficient in BIM tools (e.g., Revit , Tekla , Navisworks , Revizto , etc.).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie).
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., BIM 360, Aconex).
  • Skills in automation , data validation , and tools like Solibri , Dynamo , and Power BI .
  • Knowledge of 4D/5D modeling and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera P6).
  • Strong communicator and team player.
  • Confident, resilient, and organized.
  • Detail-oriented with strong time and pressure management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

title: Analista de Gente e Performance
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Envio de insumos para a folha de pagamento (hora extra, ausência/atraso, atestados, movimentações/promoções);
  • Acompanhamento de férias e licenças dos colaboradores junto ao gestor;
  • Apoio a liderança no gerenciamento do ponto eletrônico das equipes;
  • Relação com sindicato para acompanhamento do dissídio e acordo coletivo (CCT) das categorias;
  • Recrutamento e seleção das posições em aberto no shopping;
  • Admissão, desligamento e homologação, benefícios, segurança do trabalho e saúde ocupacional (SST);
  • Atuação como preposto em ações trabalhistas;
  • Gestão dos contratos de Estágio e Aprendizagem, sendo o ponto focal na relação com os integradores;
  • Apoio no processo de Avaliação de Desempenho;
  • Atendimento aos profissionais e clientes internos;
  • Planejamento e execução das ações de Endomarketing e campanhas de prevenção da saúde;
  • Gestão de pagamento dos fornecedores.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo em Recursos Humanos, Administração e afins;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Necessário experiência na área de Recursos Humanos/Departamento Pessoal.

title: Architect
description:
Architect | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As an Architect at ALEC, you’ll be responsible for ensuring seamless architectural coordination from tender through construction. You’ll manage technical submissions, resolve design conflicts, and act as a key link between subcontractors, design managers, and site teams, ensuring the highest standards of delivery and documentation across the board.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review and manage tender and IFC models and documentation (2D, BIM, asset data) per ISO19650 standards.
  • Identify design conflicts and coordinate resolution via RFIs, CVIs, and design workshops.
  • Coordinate with multi-disciplinary teams and support subcontractor design alignment.
  • Assist in the preparation and maintenance of project documentation, submittal schedules, and QA/QC procedures.
  • Ensure timely, accurate document submissions and shop drawing updates through coordination with modelers and document controllers.
  • Review subcontractor/shop drawings for compliance with project specifications.
  • Liaise with planning teams to keep design timelines in sync with project progress.
  • Support value engineering initiatives and design change management.
  • Oversee and ensure accuracy of redline/as-built documentation and updates.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture or equivalent
  • 8–10 years of experience, including 3–5 years in a Senior Architect role with a main contractor
  • Strong proficiency in Revit (essential)
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, Autodesk Revit, Adobe Acrobat, and MS Office
  • Solid understanding of large-scale building projects
  • Ability to interpret, review, and coordinate technical construction documentation
  • Familiarity with ISO19650 BIM standards is a strong advantage
  • Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Project Manager for Brazil (Utility)
description:
Hoymiles Power Electronics Inc., -– short Hoymiles (688032.SH)-is a globally leading inverter manufacturer with offices and services around the globe. The headquarters is based in Hangzhou China and the R&D department and manufacturing facilities are based there. Hoymiles has a significant R&D team to design and manufacture state-of-the art microinverters & hybird inverter for the international markets. To develop our business in Brazil and deliver better service to our customer, build a strong technical support structure we are looking for an experienced Project Manager for Delivery of Utility in Brazil , reporting to head of technical support HQ .

1. Collaborate with sales team to plan and complete technical exchange with Brazil customers, train clients and set forth detailed technical solutions etc.

2. Hold customer trainings face-to-face and online, create and manage local technical documentation, establish a knowledge data base, and represent Hoymiles in exhibitions.

3. Analyze legal technical requirements and certifications for local and drive execution of agreed and required certificates.

4. Monitor market environment and gather Technology intelligence from competitors.Analyze product and features of competitors regular and work closely with HQ team to finish the competitive analysis.

5. Strong support to sales team, visit clients and project sites, support system planning and give guidance to PV system installations, service strategy implementation etc.

6. Maintain the service level and fulfill the service request coming from local customer especially some of our VIP customer.

7. Lead the negotiation with local service partner including 3rd party service company.

8. Follow RMA process to make sure they will be closed on-time.

Required experience and competence:

1. Based in Brazil . Can accept national travel to make sure we can deliver a good service, depends on business request.

2. Português at a native level and English fluently in business contexts.

3. Minimum of 3 years work experience in a in the renewable industry, preferably in Storage business.

4. electrician certificate is mandatory.

5. Bachelor degree or above: must be electrical or electronics background.

6. Self-driven working mind set, willing to dig in and find out problems, report with clear logic, always providing multi proposals to choose from.

7. International mindset for a multi-cultural environment.

title: Supervisor de TAX Indiretos
description:
Sobre a área

A Consultoria Tributária é a ponte entre a complexidade das leis fiscais e as decisões estratégicas das empresas. Atuamos com foco em inteligência fiscal, identificando oportunidades de economia, mitigações de riscos e garantindo o compliance com a legislação. É uma área dinâmica, que combina análise técnica, visão de negócio e proximidade com o cliente — ideal para quem gosta de desafios, atualização constante e impacto direto nos resultados das organizações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar projetos de revisão fiscal e apuração de tributos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS), assegurando o correto cumprimento das obrigações tributárias.
  • Identificar riscos fiscais e oportunidades de recuperação de créditos e eficiência tributária, com foco consultivo e estratégico.
  • Realizar a interpretação e análise de documentos fiscais, contábeis e societários, aplicando conhecimento técnico às operações tributárias indiretas.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com clareza e objetividade, evidenciando impactos financeiros e recomendações práticas.
  • Apoiar clientes na compreensão e adequação à legislação, traduzindo pontos técnicos em linguagem acessível.
  • Fazer a ponte entre clientes, sócios e demais áreas da empresa (contábil, legal, financeira), promovendo um trabalho colaborativo.
  • Supervisionar as entregas da equipe (analistas e consultores juniores), promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e garantindo a qualidade dos trabalhos.
  • Participar de propostas comerciais, reuniões com clientes e contribuir para o fortalecimento da área de TAX Indiretos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em apuração, revisão e planejamento de tributos indiretos.
  • Domínio das legislações de ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS, e dos regimes tributários: Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional.
  • Vivência em revisão de compliance fiscal, levantamento de créditos tributários e regimes especiais é um diferencial.
  • Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para lidar com diferentes interlocutores.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado é desejável.

Competências comportamentais:

  • Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Proatividade e perfil hands-on.
  • Liderança e foco em desenvolvimento de equipe.
  • Organização e foco em resultados.

Benefícios

  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida

title: Pessoa Analista de Controladoria SR
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

MISSÃO

Atuar de forma estratégica e analítica nas áreas de Controladoria e Planejamento Financeiro, com foco no monitoramento da performance econômico-financeira. Será responsável por acompanhar os indicadores de unidade operacional, contribuindo para a eficiência da gestão orçamentária e a melhoria contínua da rentabilidade do negócio.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Consolidar e analisar resultados financeiros mensais, orçamentos, forecasts e projeções de longo prazo;
  • Acompanhar e o processo orçamentário da unidade operacional e atuar na governança de custos; Apoio na elaboração e análise dos vários exercícios de previsão, orçamento anual e no Plano a Médio Prazo (MTP). Principalmente através da interação e do diálogo com as áreas de negócio;
  • Acompanhar e propor melhorias nos KPIs financeiros e operacionais, com foco em rentabilidade e eficiência;
  • Desenvolver modelos financeiros e relatórios gerenciais para subsidiar decisões estratégicas da diretoria;
  • Atuar de forma proativa na identificação de desvios, riscos e oportunidades financeiras; Analisar, monitorar e comunicar mensalmente o desempenho real, assegurando o alinhamento com os objetivos anuais; Contribuir para o reporte e comunicação da síntese dos resultados reais e do orçamento/MTP da Unidade de Negócio (UN);
  • Participar de comitês financeiros e operacionais, representando a área de controladoria;
  • Apoiar projetos transversais de melhoria contínua, automação e transformação digital financeira

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade;
  • Experiência em Controladoria, planejamento financeiro e análise de performance;
  • Domínio de Excel e ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power Point, Power BI ou similares);
  • Capacidade de atuação estratégica, visão de negócio, e comunicação com alta liderança;
  • Inglês avançado.

Diferenciais

  • Pós Graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas afins será um diferencial.

LOCAL DE TRABALHO

Rio de Janeiro - RJ - Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Foreman
description:
Foreman – UAE

Are you a hands-on site leader with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and daily execution excellence?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Foreman, you’ll take frontline responsibility for executing daily site activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. You’ll lead your team on the ground, translating technical drawings into action and ensuring work progresses according to project plans.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner on some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value reliability, innovation, and our people. Join us to lead high-performing site teams that drive delivery excellence.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Senior Foreman and work closely with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, and supporting departments including QA/QC and planning. You’ll lead a small team of operatives and coordinate resources to maintain daily momentum and deliver consistent progress.

Your Role

As a Foreman, you will:

  • Lead daily site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, on time, and to the required quality.
  • Coordinate labour, materials, and equipment to optimise workflow and minimise downtime.
  • Enforce ALEC safety protocols and foster a culture of compliance and awareness.
  • Read and interpret drawings to ensure correct execution and alignment with design intent.
  • Monitor progress and take corrective action to overcome site-level challenges.
  • Maintain accurate records of progress and workforce deployment.
  • Support and motivate your team, resolve on-site issues, and escalate where required.
  • Contribute to improvements in efficiency, cost control, and construction methods.
  • This is a full-time role following a Monday to Saturday work week typical of site-based positions in our industry.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 5+ years in a Foreman or similar site-based supervisory role within the GCC.
  • Technical Knowledge : Practical understanding of construction activities, materials, and sequencing.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to guide and manage small site teams effectively.
  • Communication : Clear verbal and written communication with team members and engineers.
  • Skills : Skilled in site planning, resource coordination, and drawing interpretation.
  • Safety-First Mindset : Strong awareness of HSE principles and site compliance.
  • Tools : Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); First Aider certification preferred.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

title: Draughtsman - Civil
description:
Civil Draughtsman - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil Draughtsman , you will be responsible for creating the technical drawings and plans that serve as the foundation for our construction projects. You will transform architectural and engineering concepts into accurate, detailed drawings that guide project teams through every phase of construction. Your work will ensure that our designs are clearly communicated, compliant with regulations, and efficiently executed on site.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Prepare detailed architectural and structural drawings for building construction projects.
  • Develop general arrangement (GA) drawings, foundation plans, sections, elevations, and detail drawings.
  • Support the design team by translating conceptual sketches and technical data into accurate CAD drawings.
  • Collaborate on the development of structural layouts, floor plans, and utility networks.
  • Update and revise designs based on feedback from engineers, architects, or site observations.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with local building codes, design standards, and project specifications.
  • Maintain organized and version-controlled drawing files within the design department.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (electrical, mechanical) to ensure design integration and conflict resolution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Familiarity with Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM software is advantageous.
  • Understanding of construction methods, site logistics, and temporary works.
  • Experience with local authority drawing submissions and approval processes.
  • Bachelor's in Civil Engineering / Drafting Technology or equivalent.
  • Proven experience as a draughtsman in the building construction or architectural design industry.
  • High proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM tools are a strong advantage.
  • Good understanding of civil and structural design principles and building systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple design tasks simultaneously.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

Kindly upload your CV in English.

title: Exploration Geology Projects Manager - Industrial & New-Material Commodities (The Middle East)
description:
The Company

Globe 24-7 in partnership with a key client in Saudi Arabia are working together to source experienced and qualified talent for their mineral extraction operation.

The Role

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing and managing a team of geologists, contributing to the advanced-stage exploration of Industrial Minerals (IM) and New Materials (NM). The focus is on delivering resources in core commodities and supporting the Exploration & Resource Development (ERD) strategy. This role plays a key part in advancing the corporate Strategy 2040 by targeting areas with the highest geological potential. The position reports to the Director of Generative Exploration.

The Responsibilities

  • Support the identification, testing, and delineation of targets across advanced-stage Industrial Minerals (IM) and New Materials (NM) commodities.
  • Develop and implement strategic exploration plans for advanced-stage IM & NM, including target prioritization and cost management.
  • Direct the identification and evaluation of new IM & NM deposits with potential for economic or industrial development.
  • Lead the preparation of exploration operations plans, budgets, and justifications; monitor expenditure to ensure adherence and prevent over- or underspending.
  • Track and assess key performance indicators (KPIs) for advanced-stage IM & NM exploration (e.g., drill targets, new resources).
  • Oversee and manage geological research activities within your team; act as a subject matter expert in geology.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely exploration reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design and manage exploration programs and site investigations to identify deposits viable for future economic extraction.
  • Foster a "Safety First" culture and ensure full implementation of the Environment, Health, Safety, and Security (EHSS) management system across the exploration team.
  • Champion innovation through automation, digitalization, artificial intelligence, and data analytics to optimize exploration operations.

The Requirements

  • Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in a relevant Geoscience discipline from an accredited institution; PhD preferred
  • Minimum of 15 years’ experience in geology within the mining industry, including 10–15 years in mineral exploration and development with a strong emphasis on greenfield targeting and grassroots exploration
  • At least 3 years in a management or leadership role, overseeing exploration teams and projects
  • Proven multi-commodity and multi-jurisdiction exploration background, with demonstrated expertise in copper, nickel, zinc, lithium, silver, gold, and rare earth element (REE) systems, particularly within Archean crustal environments
  • Strong understanding of mineral deposit geology, mineral systems, and the challenges of discovery under cover
  • Hands-on experience across at least two major exploration terrains or belts, and deep technical knowledge of at least two commodities, with working knowledge of at least two others or advanced understanding of specific exploration processes
  • Direct experience with multiple mineralization styles, including porphyry copper-gold and magmatic nickel-copper systems
  • Proficient in a full range of exploration methods and capable of selecting the most effective techniques based on project needs and context
  • Significant exposure to known deposits through extensive field visits or mine site secondments
  • Strong commitment to maintaining and promoting high safety standards in field operations
  • Highly skilled in field analysis, mapping, sampling, geological documentation, reporting, and mentoring of junior geoscientists
  • Demonstrated experience in identifying and interpreting geoscientific and geophysical datasets across multiple scales
  • Strong project management capabilities, including strategic planning, budgeting, work planning, and team coordination

The Rewards

  • The position offers a competitive remuneration package. Lodgings are modern and secure.
  • FIFO roster

Contact Us

Please apply directly by submitting your resume, preferably as a Microsoft Word document.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão?

• Atuar como referência técnica em normas contábeis, com domínio em: IFRS 16 – Arrendamentos, CPC 25 – Provisões, Passivos Contingentes e Ativos Contingentes, e CPC 27 – Ativo Imobilizado.

• Liderar a estruturação e manutenção de políticas contábeis e controles internos relacionados às rotinas contábeis.

• Promover a transformação da área contábil, reestruturando processos, times e entregas com foco em compliance, eficiência e escalabilidade.

• Ser protagonista nas interações com áreas pares, promovendo soluções conjuntas e sinergias nos processos de fechamento e reporte.

• Liderar, desenvolver e engajar o time contábil, com foco em performance e entregas confiáveis.

• Contribuir com a implementação e/ou evolução de sistemas ERP, com uso intensivo de SAP (preferencialmente), incluindo histórico de participação em projetos.

• Apoiar a jornada de fortalecimento da governança corporativa e crescimento sustentável da organização, combinando visão estratégica e conhecimento técnico.

Para isso, precisamos que você possua :

• Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no CRC (obrigatório).

• Pós-graduação em Controladoria, Finanças ou áreas correlatas de Business.

• Inglês avançado, com fluência verbal e escrita para comunicação com auditorias e stakeholders internacionais.

• Desejável: Especialização ou certificação formal em normas internacionais de contabilidade (IFRS).

• Experiência em contabilidade de empresas de capital aberto no Brasil e/ou exterior.

• Desejável vivência em processos de IPO ou ambiente pré-IPO.

• Passagem por Big Four será considerada um diferencial relevante.

• Domínio das normas IFRS e CPCs aplicáveis.

• Vivência com ERP SAP e experiência em implementação ou melhorias de sistemas.

• Perfil de liderança colaborativa, com forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e orientação para soluções.

• Mentalidade de transformação e protagonismo, com atuação técnica sólida e visão estratégica de longo prazo.

title: Consultant
description:
This role can be in Sao Paulo or Rio.

Heidrick Consulting Brazil

You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.

You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as an Engagement Leader, you will expand and deepen your consulting skills by leading various projects as well as managing junior team members. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.

Primary Responsibilities

The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.

You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
  • Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
  • Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
  • Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
  • Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
  • Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
  • Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
  • Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
  • Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.

The Ideal Candidate:

Passionate and Engaged: Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.

Self-Driven and Inquisitive: Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.

Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player: Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.

Minimum Role Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
  • An undergraduate degree is required.
  • Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
  • Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
  • Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
  • Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor.   • Problem-solving and critical thinking : Quickly analyze issues, anticipate potential challenges, and implement effective solutions to maintain operational efficiency.

About the Company:

With more than three decades of expertise in the offshore sector, we bring a comprehensive and versatile approach to engineering. Our commitment to innovative solutions and determination to overcome complex challenges have positioned us as a trusted partner in significant offshore projects across the globe. Driven by a spirit of exploration, we are also expanding into groundbreaking initiatives within the renewable energy industry.

title: "Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior" #974636
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar soluções de infraestrutura Linux on-premises para sistemas de missão crítica.
  • Gerenciar e implementar ambientes virtualizados, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e alta disponibilidade.
  • Manter e integrar APIs Java, aplicações Angular, fluxos Camunda BPM e Cisco NSO.
  • Implementar e dar suporte a mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka) e bancos de dados relacionais/não relacionais.
  • Criar automações com Ansible e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Administrar redes, VPNs, ACLs, VLANs e configurar segurança, monitoramento e observabilidade.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura na melhoria contínua e confiabilidade dos ambientes.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu) em ambientes críticos on-premises.
  • Virtualização (VMware ou similares), alta disponibilidade e clusters.
  • Dockerização de aplicações (APIs Java, Angular, mensageria).
  • Automação de infraestrutura (Ansible, Terraform, Shell/Python), pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins).
  • Redes avançadas: IP, subnetting, roteamento, VLANs, VPNs, NAT, ACLs, DNS, troubleshooting e integração com Cisco.
  • Load balancing e escalabilidade (NGINX ou similares).
  • Mensageria corporativa (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MariaDB, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integração e suporte a APIs Java, Angular e Camunda BPM.
  • Monitoramento (Zabbix ou similares).
  • Segurança de infraestrutura (hardening, firewalls, controle de acesso, segregação de ambientes).
  • Bancos relacionais e não relacionais, automações com Ansible e pipelines CI/CD
  • Versionamento e IaC com Git e Terraform.
  • Formação: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Redes ou áreas relacionadas.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Híbrido, 2x na semana

  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
  • Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.

  • Domínio de CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.).
